summary.en: Al-Shabaab fighters captured a village near Mataban in central Somalia, expanding their territorial control. In Minnesota, Somali-American Uber driver Mohamed Yusuf was brutally assaulted, his car stolen and he was run over, leaving him in a coma and prompting calls for a hate-crime investigation. Ethiopia’s Moyale clashes disrupted livelihoods as a territorial dispute deepened, affecting cross-border communities. The conflict in Somalia produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al-Shabaab-krigere erobret en landsby nær Mataban i sentrale Somalia, og utvidet sitt territoriale kontroll. I Minnesota ble den somaliske amerikanske Uber-sjåføren Mohamed Yusuf brutalt angrepet, bilen hans stjålet og han ble kjørt over, noe som førte til koma og har ført til krav om etterforskning av hatkriminalitet. Konfliktene i Moyale i Etiopia forstyrret levebrød da en territoriekonflikt eskalerte, og påvirket grensefellesskapene. Konflikten i Somalia førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
